summary.text: Rise of the Eldrazi takes place on Zendikar, where Sorin Markov, Nahiri and Ugin once trapped the Eldrazi titans in a hedron prison centered on the Eye of Ugin.
When Nissa Revane, guiding Sorin to the Eye, shatters the central hedron, the titans are released, and Sorin abandons both the plane and Nissa.
Eldrazi spawn then swarm across the land, killing people where they stand and leaving no safe pockets of civilization, so adventurers abandon treasure hunting and prepare to fight them.
